contexts.text: Noah removed the covering of the ark () = the removal of falsities... The covering = what obstructs or prevents the man from seeing heaven, or the light; and this was falsity.

When man has arrived at a state in which he acts from good, or the will, he ought not to betake himself to his former state... which is signified by, Let him that is upon the roof of the house not go down to take anything out of his house (). (These words = the second class of men within the Church - those who are in charity towards the neighbour. AC 3653.)
There appeared walls, but no roof.
They make for themselves roofs...
The roof (of the altar) () = what is inmost. The reason a roof = what is inmost, is that it is what is highest... and also because it = the like as the head with man...
As by the roof is signified what is celestial good also is signified. Illustrated.
As a roof = good, the ancients had roofs on their houses where they walked, and also where they adored. Illustrated.
(Thus) a roof = the good of love.
The roof was round.
Their houses have a flat roof, around which there is a border sloping downwards.
Like one looking from the roof of a house.
Gog and Magog mean a roof and a floor.
The roof was of plates of gold.
The ground made a roof over them.
A radiant light... inflowed through the roof.
I seemed to be elevated to the roof, and to adhere to it with my head.
The chambers were devoid of a roof.
(In a Hell of Genii) there were walls... but no roof... They cannot dwell in houses with roofs... they would feel suffocated... The reason is that roofs = the closure (of thought).
The roof of the house () = the intelligence which is from genuine truths, thus also the genuine truths through which is intelligence.
The roof = what is inmost.
Roofs interior things.
